tool.name: Couple carrier screening
tool.description: reproductive risk from two partners' exome findings: recessive and X-linked conditions, treatability
tool.command: #import re #set $na = re.sub(r"[^\w .,:()+-]", "_", str($partner_a.element_identifier)) #set $nb = re.sub(r"[^\w .,:()+-]", "_", str($partner_b.element_identifier)) python3 '$__tool_directory__/wes_couple.py' --a '$partner_a' --b '$partner_b' --a-name '$na' --b-name '$nb' #if str($sex_a) != "report": --a-sex '$sex_a' #end if #if str($sex_b) != "report": --b-sex '$sex_b' #end if --carrier-genes '$carrier_genes' --miss $miss --html '$report' --tsv '$table'

param.name: partner_a
param.label: Partner A: clinical findings (table)
param.help: The 'Clinical findings (table)' of the exome clinical report (0.13.0 or later records the genetic sex).

param.name: carrier_genes
param.label: Carrier gene table
param.help: Built with data/build_carrier_genes.py: recessive and X-linked genes with carrier frequencies (gnomAD v4.1, ClinVar), newborn screening and ClinGen pediatric actionability.

param.name: miss
param.label: Share of carriers an exome misses
param.help: Used for the other partner's residual carrier chance (CNVs, deep-intronic variants, repeats).

tool.help:
**What it does**
Reproductive carrier screening of a couple from the findings tables of their two exome reports:
* **Both partners carriers** of a pathogenic or likely pathogenic allele in the same autosomal recessive gene: 1 in 4 risk per pregnancy (1 in 2 when a partner already has two alleles). * **X-linked**: a female carrier has a 1 in 2 chance of an affected son. * **One partner a carrier**: the other partner's residual chance of being an undetected carrier (the gene's carrier frequency in gnomAD v4.1 times the share of carriers an exome misses), so that targeted follow-up can be offered. * **Treatable**: the condition is on the US newborn screening panel (RUSP) or ClinGen's pediatric actionability curation scores the intervention as effective (2 or 3 of 3).
Carrier alleles are ClinVar pathogenic/likely pathogenic (not conflicting, not low-penetrance or risk factor) or the report's automated P/LP class, and high-confidence CNV deletions of recessive genes. Low-confidence calls (paralogous genes such as HBA2, VWF, NEB) are kept and marked for confirmation.
**Not detected by an exome**: SMN1 copy number (spinal muscular atrophy), HBA1/HBA2 deletions (alpha thalassemia), FMR1 repeats (fragile X), CYP21A2 and other pseudogene-rich genes, deep-intronic variants. Genetic counselling is needed before acting on any result.
